newsitem.title: USA: Enron restores S.D. gas compressor station.
newsitem.headline: Enron restores S.D. gas compressor station.

text.p: Enron Corp said a natural gas compressor station on its Northern Border natural gas pipeline returned to service this afternoon as expected after it was shut down this weekend for a valve repair.
The outage at the station, near Aberdeen, S.D., did not affect the approximately 1.7 billion cubic feet per day of deliveries on the Northern Border system, Enron reported earlier today.

The Northern Border pipeline interconnects with Foothills Pipeline at the Monchy, the Canadian gas export point into Montana. Traveling southeast, the line then interconnects with the Northern Natural pipeline system in South Dakota and Iowa, and with Natural Gas Pipeline in Iowa and Illinois.
